verdict.rationale: The only scheduling evidence is a scheduled Slack digest of the Triage queue (coderabbit-docs-36), which is a narrow, fixed-purpose recurring delivery rather than general user-defined recurring jobs or workflows. Other automation, such as auto-reviews on PR events and finishing-touch recipes, is event- or manually-triggered, not scheduled. Missing for 10: general-purpose cron or recurring job scheduling, scheduled custom recipes or agentic workflows, scheduled scans or reviews, documentation of schedule configuration, independent corroboration.
